item.title: General Rezaei: Any evil act against Iran will bring affliction on US to be recorded in history
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) Major General Mohsen Rezaei has warned the United States that any new military aggression against the Islamic Republic would draw a forceful response against American military and economic interests, while stressing that Washington must take concrete steps before Tehran reopens the Strait of Hormuz.

Tehran, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council (SNSC) Major General Mohsen Rezaei has warned the United States that any new military aggression against the Islamic Republic would draw a forceful response against American military and economic interests, while stressing that Washington must take concrete steps before Tehran reopens the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Araghchi’s message of appreciation to President Pezeshkian: Diplomacy is at forefront of defending Iran

item.title: President: All legal rights of Iranian nation must be recognized
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in a meeting in Tehran on Thursday with visiting Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani emphasized the need for recognizing all the rights of the Iranian nation within the framework of international law, saying that the Islamic Republic of Iran demands nothing beyond its legal rights and will not yield to pressure or coercion.
